# Required third-party notices

AlterDPI product development and network adaptation: **Furkan Okan**.

- GoodbyeDPI 0.2.3rc3 — ValdikSS and contributors; Apache-2.0. The original x64 executable is packaged under the name `network-engine.exe`; its bytes are unchanged. Original source and licenses are included.
- WinDivert 2.2.0-D — basil00 and contributors; LGPL-3.0 / GPL-2.0 alternatives. Original DLL and signed driver bytes are unchanged. Relevant licenses and corresponding source are included.
- ARSoft.Tools.Net 3.6.1 — Alexander Reinert; Apache-2.0. DNS parser/client/server interfaces are used.
- HaGeZi DNS blocklists, Threat Intelligence Feeds Mini — Gerd HaGeZi; GPL-3.0. The bundled domain list is normalized and deduplicated for lookup. Its original source is https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists/tree/main/wildcard .
- .NET and Microsoft runtime packages — Microsoft and contributors; MIT and their associated third-party notices. Published runtime license files are retained.
- BouncyCastle.Cryptography, transitive dependency of the DNS library — The Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc.; its published license and notices are retained.
- NSIS — its authors and contributors; zlib/libpng and component licenses with redistribution terms. Used for the installer; original license is included.

Required notices must remain with distributed copies. They are separate from the consumer-facing AlterDPI interface.
